import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int mod;
    static int[] jc, inv;
    static int[][] f;
    static long[] g;
    static int[] cnt;
    static int l, m;

    static int upd(int x) {
        if (x < 0) return x + mod;
        if (x >= mod) return x - mod;
        return x;
    }

    static void add(int[] arr, int idx, int val) {
        arr[idx] = upd(arr[idx] + val);
    }

    static int ksm(int x, int k) {
        int ans = 1;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) ans = (int)((long)ans * x % mod);
            x = (int)((long)x * x % mod);
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static void init(int n) {
        jc = new int[n + 1];
        inv = new int[n + 1];
        jc[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            jc[i] = (int)((long)jc[i - 1] * i % mod);
        }
        inv[n] = ksm(jc[n], mod - 2);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv[i] = (int)((long)inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod);
        }
    }

    static void F(int[] f, int n, int h) {
        for (int p = 1; p < n; p <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += p << 1) {
                for (int k = i; k <= i + p - 1; k++) {
                    add(f, k + p, h * f[k]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long[] multiplyVectors(long[] A, long[] B) {
        long[] C = new long[l + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= l; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= l - i; j++) {
                C[i + j] += A[i] * B[j];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= l; i++) {
            C[i] %= mod;
        }
        return C;
    }

    static long[] pksm(long[] A, int k) {
        long[] C = new long[l + 1];
        C[0] = 1;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) C = multiplyVectors(C, A);
            A = multiplyVectors(A, A);
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return C;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();

        init(n);
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(ksm(k, n));
            return;
        }

        m = 1;
        l = 0;
        while (m <= n) {
            m <<= 1;
            l++;
        }

        cnt = new int[m];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            cnt[i] = cnt[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
        }

        init(m);
        f = new int[19][m];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            f[cnt[i]][i] = inv[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= l; i++) {
            F(f[i], m, 1);
        }

        g = new long[l + 1];
        for (int s = 0; s < m; s++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= l; i++) {
                g[i] = f[i][s];
            }
            long[] res = pksm(g, k);
            for (int i = 0; i <= l; i++) {
                f[i][s] = (int) res[i];
            }
        }

        F(f[cnt[n]], m, -1);
        int ans = upd(ksm(k, n) - (int)((long)f[cnt[n]][n] * jc[n] % mod));
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
